purpose: Complete supplemental P205 observations, adverse results and limits; no original acceptance promotion

definitions.OFF: Single performance.now elapsed around actual awaited API. Pre-invocation checkpoint, fixture/input construction, oracle/hash checks and cleanup excluded. No numeric probe. Includes actual API wall wait, scheduling and worker/IDB latency. All raw float values preserved.
definitions.ON: Separate newly seeded database and invocation sequence. Raw probe counters/events are instrumentation-affected work diagnostics, not OFF latency. API settled before numeric counter settlement. Every final ON row fulfilled with settled capture and zero pending native transactions.
definitions.pairing: Identical suite, literal fixed input, seven overlay bytes, operation labels/order and API options; independent fresh databases. Supplemental successful API prefixes compare; failed baseline UI suffix never compared as equivalent successful latency.
definitions.missingMetrics: Raw absent counter keys remain unrecorded, never filled with zero. Baseline lacks declared world/UI gauges: UNKNOWN. Gauge values are instantaneous last samples; counters sum instrumented calls/rows/bytes, not unique rows, physical IDB bytes or retained heap.
definitions.storeRetention: Direct outside-interval cachedProjects/contentHeads/cachedHistoryIds/completeHistories/cacheEpochs sizes. records=sum entities+relations of cached graphs; canonicalBytes=sum UTF-8 JSON bytes of cached graphs including cached history. Caller-owned weak tokens, drafts, active save captures and canonical IDB/outbox/assets lie outside this inactive budget.
definitions.UIRegistry: Separate actual ON UI gauge: registry object entries; unique project object identities; sum current entities+relations; serialized JSON payload. Shared/caller-owned other views may retain graphs. Unsupported baseline gauge UNKNOWN.
definitions.heap: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage instantaneous renderer/isolate values in separately fresh SMALL six-source fixture context, regardless of original suite flag. No forcedGC, peak, retained/reachable heap or release acceptance; original Large/72MiB memory UNKNOWN.
definitions.strictUnfavorable: candidateMilliseconds > baselineMilliseconds on exact stored raw floats, including very small near-tie jitter. No rounded-value omission, statistical inference, p95 or threshold acceptance.
